chunks: 4436 - And Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Abu Ubaydah Al-Hadhdha', who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah عليه السلام say:
"A woman is not married alongside her paternal aunt, nor alongside her maternal aunt, nor alongside her sister through breastfeeding."

He said: And he عليه السلام said, "Indeed, Ali عليه السلام mentioned the daughter of Hamzah to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, and he said: 'Did you not know that she is the daughter of my brother through breastfeeding?'"
And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and Hamzah had both suckled from the milk of one woman.

key_terms.أَخِي مِنَ ٱلرَّضَاعَةِ: my brother through breastfeeding, indicating milk-kinship
key_terms.أُخْتِهَا مِنَ ٱلرَّضَاعَةِ: her sister through breastfeeding, whose milk-kinship carries marriage prohibition
key_terms.خَالَتِهَا: her maternal aunt, likewise prohibited in concurrent marriage
key_terms.عَمَّتِهَا: her paternal aunt, whose concurrent marriage creates a prohibited union
key_terms.لَبَنِ ٱمْرَأَةٍ: the milk of a woman, through which the milk relationship was established
key_terms.ٱبْنَةُ حَمْزَةَ: the daughter of Hamzah, mentioned as an example in the ruling
key_terms.ٱلْمَرْأَةُ: the woman being taken in marriage

ai.seo_question: What marriage prohibitions are established through breastfeeding in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning prohibited combinations in marriage, including marrying a woman together with her paternal aunt, maternal aunt, or her milk-sister. It also cites the case of Hamzah’s daughter to show that kinship established through breastfeeding has legal effect in marriage prohibition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4436 - And it is narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Abu Ubaydah Al-Hadhdha' that he said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (as) say: "A woman cannot be married alongside her paternal aunt, nor alongside her maternal aunt, nor alongside her sister through breastfeeding."

Imam (as) also said: "Indeed, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) mentioned the daughter of Hamza to the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family). The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Do you not know that she is the daughter of my brother through breastfeeding?'
And the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) and Hamza had both been nursed from the milk of the same woman."
